title: All your assets in one place
body: Vehicles, appliances, electronics, even documents — organised by room and category, so you always know what you have and where it lives.

title: Smart reminders, weeks ahead
body: Configure 60 / 30 / 7 / 1-day alerts for every renewal — delivered by push, email or WhatsApp, whichever you actually check.

title: Keep the whole family in sync
body: Invite up to 8 members. Everyone gets reminded and anyone can update — no more single point of failure when a date is due.

title: Local-first & private
body: Works offline and feels instant. Your data syncs securely in the background, encrypted in transit — yours and your family's alone.
